name: yppeople-monorepo
description: YPPEOPLE — real Express/MongoDB backend (backend/) + new Next.js frontend (web/). Legacy single-file SPA preserved in frontend/.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.start: concurrently -n backend,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:web"
